scope: Proposition 3.1 (Uniform endpoint moments) of the manuscript “GOE bulk universality for fixed-degree random regular graphs” (preprints/GOE-bulk-universality-for-fixed-degree-random-regular-graphs-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 219 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d8e092ab0484f8b9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix positive integers k, ℓ and a nonnegative integer q. There are constants c, C > 0 and events of graphs of probability tending to one with the following property. Choose distinct indices i(1), . . . , i(ℓ) satisfying |xi(j)| ≤ S2, by any rule depending only on the graph. Independently sample k uniform oriented edges (vα, v′ α), conditionally on the graph, and set bj = ( ui(j)(v1), . . . , ui(j)(vk), ui(j)(v′ 1), . . . , ui(j)(v′ k) )⊤ . For every coordinate monomial P of total degree at most q, | |E [ P(b1, . . . , bℓ) | A ] − EP(Z1, . . . , Zℓ) | | ≤ Cn−c , Z1, . . . , Zℓ independent N(0, Ck). The constants and graph events are uniform over the indicated choices of eigenindices. They may depend on d, E, k, ℓ, q; no assertion is made for dimensions or moment orders growing with n.
